title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 10/27 — "In the Storm"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 10. The narrator leaves his wife safe with her cousins at Leatherhead, white-faced in the lit doorway, and turns the borrowed dog cart back towards Maybury Hill, because he promised to return it by midnight.

The storm breaks on the road home. Green flashes burst over the hill, and in the glare of the lightning something walks across the heather: a tripod taller than a house, striding and heeling over like a milking stool bowled along the ground. The horse bolts, the cart overturns into a pool, and the narrator crouches in the furze while two of the machines go by and stoop over a third cylinder in the field.

Soaked and shaking, he climbs the lane towards home. By the fence lies a man who will never answer him.

Chapter X of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
